categories.rationale: Implements foundational type validation infrastructure in `ArgsManager` to prevent configuration coercion footguns and silent config errors. While the initial flags are restricted to tests without immediate runtime effect on existing options, it directly unblocks several follow-up PRs (#17580, #17783, #17493, #17581, #22978) to convert options to typed flags.
